description: This Java interface defines a builder for handling responses and events related to the DeleteAttributes command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides factory interfaces for creating response objects and event objects corresponding to the delete attributes operation.

classes.name: DeleteAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Main interface providing factory methods for constructing responses and events related to delete attributes commands.

classes.name: DeleteAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command response objects, including success responses and error responses indicating issues like inaccessibility or non-modifiability of attributes.

classes.name: DeleteAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects, specifically the AttributesDeleted event triggered by delete attribute commands.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a DeleteAttributesResponse indicating successful deletion.

methods.name: attributesNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates a ThingErrorResponse indicating attributes were not accessible.

methods.name: attributesNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates a ThingErrorResponse indicating attributes were not modifiable.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates an AttributesDeleted event indicating attributes have been deleted.
